en: A monochrome postcard view of a river crossing with a ferry landing. In the foreground are cobblestones, railings, a horse-drawn cart, and several people near a small pier structure with posts and cables. Across the wide river a long metal bridge spans from left to right. The style is early 20th century. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as the ferry from Nijmegen to Lent and a small serial number appears in the lower left.
